[1/4] Planning native file system save and load engine

impact_assessment.why: Provide persistent, native file system saving and loading directly to/from local disk alongside localStorage
impact_assessment.benefits: Enables true local-first desktop-grade saving, direct file sync to disk via File System Access API, Ctrl+S shortcuts, and portable backups
impact_assessment.risks: contract: must not break existing localStorage auto-save; dependency: standard browser APIs with zero external dependencies; concurrency: handle async file write locks; state: preserve schema versioning
impact_assessment.mitigation: Wrap File System Access API with progressive enhancement, graceful fallback to Blob download and file input in unsupported environments
